name: Lying Calf Stretch
steps: Lie on your back with one foot planted and loop a towel around the ball of your other foot.
Extend the working leg upward toward the ceiling with your knee straight while holding both ends of the towel.
Pull the towel gently downward to draw your toes toward your shin until you feel a clear stretch along your calf.
Hold the stretch calmly with slow breaths on one leg, then release gently and switch sides.
tips: Keep your working knee straight and your shoulders relaxed back against the floor.
Apply steady, mild tension on the towel without bouncing.
